instruction.name: movfrh2gr.s
instruction.description: Extract the high 32 bits of fj into rd.

experiments.name: register round trip
experiments.notes: Register round trip measured at 4.99 cycles; subtracting the 3-cycle movgr2frh.w leaves 2. Every closed chain crosses the boundary both ways, so the split between the two directions is a microarchitectural choice, not an independent measurement.

latencies.notes: fj -> rd. The chain closes through st.d/fld.d; its 10.37-cycle cost is calibrated by replacing the move with movfr2gr.s (2 cycles). Raw spread 13.09-13.19 cycles. Measured on 2026-11-17 on LA464, core 0. Raw value was 2.75 cycles; the recorded nominal value is the nearest whole cycle, matching the repository convention.

notes: movfrh2gr.s is 2 cycles. Measured as a closed register round trip with the opposite direction subtracted; the round trip is additive with known-latency instructions inserted in between. Every cross-domain move on LA464 is 2 cycles per direction, with movgr2frh.w at 3 and the flag pair at 7/15 cycles. Re-derived with the two-cycle cross-domain calibration: movfr2gr and movgr2fr are 2 cycles each, movgr2frh.w is 3, the flag pair is 7/15, vpickve2gr is 3, xvpickve2gr is 5, and vreplgr2vr/xvreplgr2vr are 2 (3 for the byte and half-word broadcast).
